name: Enduring Assembly
rules_text: Put an Aura Stack (+1/+1) on each of up to two target creatures you control.

name: Shield of the Horizon
rules_text: Airborne (can only be responded to by Airborne creatures or creatures that can respond to Airborne creatures). When this creature comes into play, Gain 1 Aura for each creature you control.

name: Gleamwater Reader
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, look at the top 2 cards of your deck; put any on the bottom in any order.

name: Last Reflection
rules_text: Return target creature or Seal to its owner's hand.

name: Admiral of the Still Sea
rules_text: Can be played any time you could play a Mudra. When this creature comes into play, Turn up to two target creatures an opponent controls.

name: Dusk Bargain
rules_text: Pick two cards and lose 2 Aura. If a creature you controlled was put into the Pit from play this Round, Gain 1 Aura.

name: Sovereign of the Empty Cairn
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, target opponent sacrifices a creature. If they do, you Gain Aura equal to that creature's toughness.

name: Copper Relay
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, it deals 1 damage to target opponent.

name: Faultline Signal
rules_text: This Mantra deals 3 damage to target creature. If that creature is confronting, this Mantra also deals 1 damage to its controller.

name: The Last Kiln
rules_text: When this Artifact comes into play, it deals 3 damage to any target. {2}{R}, {TURN}, Put a card from your hand into the Pit: This Artifact deals 2 damage to any target.

name: Crown of the Old Canopy
rules_text: Bind to target creature. Bound creature gets +2/+2 and gains Can respond to Airborne creatures.

name: Worldroot Colossus
rules_text: Extra fighting damage beyond a responder's defense hits the responding player. When this creature comes into play, put an Aura Stack (+1/+1) on up to one other target creature you control if you control six or more Lands.
